# The Lore Book
The guidebook tells you how things work. The [bold]lore book[/bold] tells you why they are there: the history of the Colossus sector, its factions, its worlds and the things that hunt in it.
Open it with the book button on the top bar, from the game menu, or from the lobby. Gold links like this one open it at the right page: [lorelink="Welcome to Colossus" link="BasicLore"].
Objects with a lore page show a book button when you examine them. Click it to read about the thing in front of you.
## Chapters
- [lorelink="Welcome to Colossus" link="BasicLore"]: the primer, the timeline and the sector today. Read this first. - [lorelink="Factions" link="Factions"]: who you can fly for, and who will shoot at you. - [lorelink="Star System" link="MonoStarSystem"]: Kyphrus, its collapse and its worlds. - [lorelink="Things That Hunt" link="WFLoreThreats"]: the Chimera and the xenonids. - [lorelink="Forbidden" link="WFLoreForbidden"]: the Monolith, the Unmooring, the Lattice and the Choir. Read them with care.
